help.background.li1: **Click the icon** to open the app window.
help.background.li2: **Right-click** the icon to open a menu with **Open GeoStoreV6 Updater**, **Check for updates** and **Exit**. Exiting turns off background mode until you next sign in to Windows or open the app again.
help.background.li3: Hover over the icon to see the time of the next check.
help.background.p1: GeoStoreV6 Updater keeps running in the background after you close its window. Its icon is in the notification area at the bottom right of the taskbar, or hidden under the arrow.
help.background.p2: When the app finds an update, it shows a Windows notification. If automatic installation is on, the notification arrives only after the installation finishes. Background mode starts automatically every time you sign in to Windows, as the scheduled task “GeoStoreV6 Updater”.
help.background.title: Background mode and notifications

help.history.p1: The **History** page shows update checks, installations and their results, grouped by day. Routine repeated entries are hidden; the **Show** link reveals them. The **Logs** menu opens:

help.legal.p2: GeoStore V6, GEOVAP and the names of the application modules are trademarks or trade names of their respective owners. The app uses them only to identify the software it works with.
help.legal.p3: The app downloads installation packages and licenses from portal.geostore.cz and the licman system under your own account. Their use is governed by your agreement with GEOVAP. For questions about this app, contact its author, not GEOVAP technical support.

help.new_install.li1: **Graphics editor** – GeoStore V6. If it is already installed, it is uninstalled and installed again.
help.new_install.li2: **Application modules** – the complete installation of each selected module is installed.
help.new_install.li3: **Hardware key driver (Sentinel HASP)** – at the end of the installation, the driver setup wizard starts and has to be completed manually.
help.new_install.li4: **Microsoft Visual C++ 2010 and 2012 (x64)** – libraries required by GeoStore V6, available only when installing the editor.
help.new_install.li5: **Floating license (gsfl.lic)** – downloads the license file from the licman system and saves it to the GeoStore V6 folder. If your account has several licenses, you choose which one to use.
help.new_install.p1: The **Clean installation** page is for installing GeoStore V6 on a new computer or for completely reinstalling selected parts. Confirm your selection with the **Start installation** button.
help.new_install.p2: **Warning:** a complete installation of an application module overwrites the configuration files in C:\V6-KONFIG and the environment settings in %LOCALAPPDATA%\GEOVAP\GSV6. Modified configuration files are backed up before they are overwritten.
help.new_install.title: Clean installation
help.overview.li1: **Installed** – the release date of the installed version and the version number on this computer
help.overview.li2: **On the portal** – the date of the newest package on the portal, in bold with a blue arrow if it is newer than the installed one
help.overview.li3: **On the right** – **Up to date**, an **Update** button when a new version is available, or **Install** for packages you don't have on this computer
help.overview.li4: **Reinstall** – installs the current version of the package again
help.overview.li5: **Mark as up to date** – if you updated the package manually, the app stops reporting it as outdated
help.overview.li6: **Stop tracking** / **Track updates** – sets whether the app watches the package for updates
help.overview.p1: The **Overview** page shows all tracked packages:
help.overview.p2: The **Check now** button checks the portal right away. When automatic checks are on and the sign-in is saved, the time of the next check follows the time of the last one. Packages that are available to you on the portal but that you don't track are listed under **Other packages available for your account**, and you can add them with the **Install** button.
help.overview.p3: The **More actions** menu at the end of each row offers:
help.overview.p4: Until the app installs a package itself, it estimates the package's status from the dates of the files on this computer. After the first installation through GeoStoreV6 Updater, the status is exact.
help.overview.title: Package overview
help.settings.li1: **Automatically check for updates** – a background check either at regular intervals (from every hour to every 24 hours) or once a day at a set time. If the computer was off at that time, the check runs as soon as it is turned on.
help.settings.li2: **Install found updates automatically** – updates are installed in the background and a notification appears when they finish. Otherwise the app only notifies you about them.
help.settings.li3: **Back up modified files** – backs up modified files in C:\V6-KONFIG before they are overwritten. We recommend leaving this on.
help.settings.li4: **Keep downloaded installation packages** – downloaded packages are not deleted after installation. They take up hundreds of MB.
help.settings.li5: **Tracked packages** – the app watches and updates the checked packages.
help.settings.li6: **Account** – the sign-in stored in Windows Credential Manager. Without it, the automatic background check does not work.
help.settings.title: Settings
help.title: Help
help.troubleshooting.a1: Check your internet connection and whether you can sign in to portal.geostore.cz in a browser. If you changed your password, sign out in the app and sign in again.
help.troubleshooting.a2: Save your work and close all GeoStore V6 windows. The installation then continues on its own.
help.troubleshooting.a3: Make sure **Do not disturb** is off and that the app is allowed to show notifications in **Windows Settings → System → Notifications**. Also check that the app icon is in the notification area. If it isn't, start the app and background mode turns back on.
help.troubleshooting.a4: In **Settings**, automatic checking must be on and the sign-in must be stored. If you moved the app to a different folder, run it once from the new location.
help.troubleshooting.a5: In the package's **More actions** menu, choose **Mark as up to date**.
help.troubleshooting.a6: On the **History** page, under **Open logs → Full application log**.
help.troubleshooting.q2: The installation is stuck on “Waiting for GeoStore V6 to close”
help.troubleshooting.q5: A package is reported as outdated even though I updated it manually
help.troubleshooting.q6: Where can I find details about what happened during an installation?
help.troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
help.uninstall.p1: In **Settings → About**, click **Uninstall app**. The app stops background mode, removes automatic startup, deletes the stored sign-in, and deletes its own file and the folder with its settings and logs.
help.uninstall.p2: GeoStore V6, the installed application modules and the backups in C:\V6-KONFIG_zalohy are left unchanged.
help.uninstall.title: Uninstalling
help.updates.li1: **GeoStore V6 must be closed.** If it is running, the installation waits and continues on its own as soon as you close it.
help.updates.li2: The **Cancel installation** button stops the installation. Some steps, such as copying files, cannot be interrupted.
help.updates.li3: Modified configuration files in C:\V6-KONFIG are backed up to C:\V6-KONFIG_zalohy before they are overwritten.
help.updates.li4: After the GeoStore V6 editor is updated, the app reinstalls the tracked application modules so that their libraries stay intact.
help.updates.p1: Click **Update all** in the top right, or **Update** next to a single package. The app shows what will change and, once you confirm, downloads and installs the packages one by one. You can follow the progress at the top of the Overview page.
help.updates.title: Installing updates
